title: The board feed kept every change between reads, so a long healthy stream grew without bound
resolution: Changes are kept only while a read runs, and a read that falls 1,000 changes behind the stream is replaced by a resync.

title: A late 401 of a request sent before a logout could end the session of a later login
resolution: Each board request takes the expiry of the session view it started under, which does nothing once a newer view showed.

title: Repeated resyncs read the board and opened a stream again at once without a limit
resolution: A first resync recovers at once; each further one before a change waits from 1 s, doubled up to 10 s, and stopping cancels it.

title: The lost-updates notice disappeared when a new stream started to connect, before it opened
resolution: A failed stream or a resync keeps the liveness lost through the re-read and the new connection until the stream opens.

title: The sideways scroll viewport of the columns took no keyboard focus
resolution: The viewport gets tabIndex 0 and is a region named Board columns through the Mantine viewportProps.

title: The loading states spun their loader under reduced motion
resolution: Under reduced motion the loading states keep their status text and leave the loader out.

title: Project pagination caught only a page that named itself as the next one, not a cycle
resolution: The adapter keeps every followed cursor and reads a page that names one of them as unreachable.

title: The record credited both verify runs with the web test results that only the second run had
resolution: The evidence check credits the web results and coverage to the second run only.

title: listProjects stopped a cycle of cursors but not a server that keeps naming new ones
resolution: The adapter reads a next beyond MAX_PROJECT_PAGES (100) pages as unreachable, so it requests at most 100 pages.

title: The 403 notice ignored the requiredRole that wire contracts section 2 gives the SPA to show
resolution: A denied read carries details.requiredRole when the answer has one, and the notice says which role reading the board needs.

title: A late 401 that a newer session view ignores left the board saying the control plane did not answer
resolution: An unauthenticated failure has its own notice, Your session ended, with a retry, instead of the unreachable text.

title: The count badge of a column with one card was named 1 cards
resolution: The badge's name uses the singular for one card, like the open items of a card.

title: The informational first-run notice kept Mantine's assertive alert role
resolution: The first-run notice has the role status like the board's other notices, and its tests find it by that role.

title: The board feed's readThenOpen shadowed the read function with its boolean outcome inside a long closure
resolution: The outcome is named shown; the suggested class was not adopted, to keep the fix minimal and behaviour-preserving.

title: The live updates requirement kept the events during a read without the 1,000 bound and the resync beyond it
resolution: The requirement keeps up to 1,000 events that arrive during a read and resyncs beyond that, at 481 characters.

title: The self-check's src/board coverage predated the pass 1 fixes
resolution: The self-check dates its numbers before the pass 1 fixes and adds those after the pass 1 and pass 2 fixes.

title: The Revision list stopped before the pass 1 fixes and did not name the reviewed head
resolution: The Revision list names the record commits, the pass 1 fixes, the re-route, and the reviewed head 4efdbca2.
